name: JW Marriott Houston Downtown
positioning: Luxury hotel in the historic Samuel F. Carter skyscraper in the heart of downtown Houston, with the Spa by JW, local art and a direct entrance to the city's underground tunnels
best_for: Travelers who want a walkable downtown Houston base near Discovery Green, the Toyota Center and the George R. Brown Convention Center
Guests who want a city spa with a couple's treatment room and suites with full kitchens

facts.text: The hotel is in the historic Samuel F. Carter skyscraper in the heart of downtown Houston.
The hotel showcases paintings and sculptures created by local artists.
The hotel is minutes from Discovery Green, the Toyota Center and the George R. Brown Convention Center.
The Metro rail passes directly in front of the hotel.
Guest rooms have plush bedding and marble bathrooms.
The Presidential and Vice Presidential Suites have separate living and dining areas and full kitchens.
The Vice Presidential Suite is a loft-style suite.
The Executive Suite bedroom has soundproof windows.
The hotel has a fitness center and a yoga studio.
The Griffin Executive Lounge is on the 11th floor.
The Foundry restaurant serves elevated American cuisine and cocktails.
Pets can be welcomed with a gourmet treat bag on arrival.

highlights.text: An entrance to Houston's underground tunnels is on the hotel's lower level.
The Spa by JW has private treatment rooms, a relaxation lounge and a couple's treatment room.
Superior rooms and suites have sculpted stone soaking tubs.
The Griffin Executive Lounge has panoramic city skyline views and serves complimentary hot breakfast.
The Presidential Suite bathroom has a soaking tub with Aromatherapy Associates products.

considerations.text: The hotel is a smoke-free property.
Guests must be at least 21 to check in.
WhataHotel notes the urban downtown setting may not appeal to travelers seeking a quiet, resort-style escape.
